title: Easy Pasta alla Norma
description: Give this pasta alla norma a try for a perfect weeknight dinner - as an Italian, it just doesn't get better than pasta and eggplant!
ingredients: 0.25 cup olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
2 sprigs fresh basil, plus more for garnish
1.5 teaspoons sea salt, or more to taste
1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until smoking. Add garlic and then eggplant and cook stirring regularly, until softened and lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Add tomatoes, basil, and thyme. Bring everything to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes. Season with sea salt and pepper to taste.

Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 2 tablespoons salt. Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain well and pour hot pasta into the skillet with eggplant mixture. Toss to combine.
Garnish with basil leaves and red pepper flakes. Drizzle some olive oil on top and serve topped with Parmesan cheese.
